What this page cannot show

Holdings, fees and the fee structure (fixed or profit-sharing) are in the portfolio manager's disclosure document and monthly factsheet, not in APMI's reports. Individual clients' returns differ from the strategy's with the timing of their money and their fee plan.

Common questions

What return has ProfitGate Classic Compounders Equity Strategy given?

−6.7% over 1 year and 11.7% a year over 3 years to Oct 2026, after fees and before tax, as reported to APMI. Its yardstick, Nifty Smallcap 250 TRI, returned 12.4% a year over the same 3 years.

How big is ProfitGate Classic Compounders Equity Strategy?

₹655 cr of client money at the end of Oct 2026.

What was its worst fall?

−23.2% from a month-end peak to a month-end low between Nov 2023 and Oct 2026; its yardstick's worst fall over the same months was −24.7%.

How is ProfitGate Classic Compounders Equity Strategy rated?

B (In line): 74 of 127 rated mid and small cap equity strategies at the quarterly review of data to Oct 2026. Ratings describe the track record against its own yardstick and peers; they are not a recommendation or a forecast.

Source: APMI (Association of Portfolio Managers in India) monthly reports, which portfolio managers file as SEBI requires. Returns are time-weighted, after all fees and expenses and before the investor's tax; periods over a year are annualised. Each strategy is compared with its own yardstick: equity with the style index it tracks most closely (total-return), debt with the median high-quality bond mutual fund, hybrid with its fitted mix of the two. Ratings describe past track records and are not a recommendation or a forecast; past performance does not guarantee future returns. PMS investments need at least ₹50 lakh, can lose value and carry higher fees than mutual funds; read the portfolio manager's disclosure document before investing.
